title: Run pane and Overview text polish sweep
lead: One sweep over the run pane, the Overview rows, the Waves screen and the status line: compact token counts, an ASCII-only gate verdict, a hang-indented Waves conflict marker, a short behind-main fallback, no "running" claim on a stopped engine row, an ordinal on repeated roles, a fix-round golden, and the missing docs rule. The live tail stays raw markdown (owner, 2026-10-31).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner, 2026-10-31: later-notes rows are folded into sweep slices, and the live tail keeps raw markdown (no stripping). This slice is hosted on S130 and folds S214 and S101 item (d). The folded rows are retired after this slice is filed.

Items, by source:

- S130 (from S99): (1) large token counts read better as `23.8k`; (2) ASCII mode prints a non-ASCII cross in the gate verdict line (`internal/tui/runtree.go:239`); (3) the tail shows assistant markdown raw, decided: keep raw, so the code does not change and a test pins it; (4) `docs/dashboard.md` does not state that the inline pane keeps six Overview rows at height 24 or more (`internal/tui/view.go:183-190`).
- S130 (from S114): (5) the Waves engine-conflict marker should hang-indent when it wraps (`internal/tui/waves.go:791-792`); (6) the behind-main notice clips mid-word in the status line below about 54 columns (`internal/tui/view.go:573-575`; the notice is 51 characters, `internal/daemon/build.go:16`), so a short fallback `behind main: ork daemon restart` (31 characters) is used when the full text does not fit.
- S130 (from S125): (7) a key to go back to three waves after `A` shows all (`internal/tui/model.go:673-686`, `internal/tui/waves.go:177-182`). Proposed: `A` toggles.
- S214 (from S108): (8) a per-role ordinal on repeated steps, so two done `implementer` lines can be told apart (*proposed*: `#N`, shown only where no `round N` is shown); (9) a golden for a failed step and a fix round with the S108 folded (one-line) done steps. Existing goldens `testdata/golden/pane-tail-*.txt` show a failed gate and a fix round, but their done steps carry no task text, so they do not show the fold.
- S101 item (d): a stopped engine row still says `2 of 6 steps running` (`internal/tui/overview.go:398-402`; `testdata/golden/engine-stopped-100x30.txt` line 5). Items (a)-(c) of S101 are stale, checked against the goldens today: (a) `testdata/golden/engine-implement-80x24.txt` line 7 now reads `ork  S22  implement  [......]`, with no padded kind column and no 24-character run id, and `testdata/golden/live-detail-80x24-mono.txt` line 7 keeps the role and bar; (b) `testdata/golden/engine-stopped-100x30.txt` shows `stopped` once; (c) the stopped age is on the row at 100 columns (`2d ago`) and is cut at 80 columns only because the row also carries `running` (item (d) removes that text, and the row then fits in 60 columns, which a test checks).

Dropped, with reasons (also in the manifest): S214 (2) "overflow marker under Recent" and S214 (4) "task-line column vs deeper child glyph": the S214 note has a title only, so their intent is not recorded here; (2) is the shared `+N more lines` window marker of every view (`internal/tui/view.go:894-910`) and (4) is documented as four columns past the node glyph (`docs/dashboard.md`, run tree node text). S125 "softer ticked-row highlight while inputs are open" and "dim `awaiting inputs` in the empty Lineup cell": no rendering is described. S125 "dim text inside the cursor style needs a look in a real terminal" is kept as a [HUMAN CHECK].

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestTokenCountsCompact` (`internal/tui/runtree_test.go`): a table for `compactTokens`: 0 gives `0`, 999 gives `999`, 1000 gives `1.0k`, 23849 gives `23.8k`, 23850 gives `23.9k`, 999949 gives `999.9k`, 999950 gives `1.0M`, 1250000 gives `1.3M`. Fails first: `compactTokens` does not exist (compile error).
- `TestTokenCountsShowCompactInPaneAndOverview`: a finished step with 23849 tokens reads `tokens 23.8k  $0.25` in the pane; an engine run with 23849 tokens reads `tokens 23.8k` in the Overview row; a count under 1000 prints as before. Fails first: both print `23849`.
- `TestAsciiGateVerdictHasNoUnicode`: with `cfg.ASCII` true, the `gate FAIL` line has only bytes below 0x80 and starts `    x gate FAIL -> implementer round 2`; with ASCII false it still starts with the cross. Fails first: the line always has the cross.
- `TestTailKeepsMarkdownRaw` (characterization, passes at once): `tailRows("# Title\n**bold** and `code`", 80, false)` returns the text unchanged. It pins the owner's decision.
- `TestWavesConflictMarkerHangIndents`: at a pane width where the marker wraps, the first line starts `  ! engine conflict` and every later line starts with four spaces, not two. Fails first: later lines start with two spaces.
- `TestBehindNoticeShortFallback`: in `statusLine(w)` the full notice shows when it fits; at widths from 33 to 51 (the full notice plus its leading space fits at 52) it reads `behind main: ork daemon restart` whole; below 33 it clips as before; the stale-build marker (`daemon build differs: ork daemon restart`) still clips as in `TestStaleStatusDropsWholeFieldsAt80x24`. Fails first: the notice clips mid-word at 40 columns.
- `TestWavesAKeyTogglesBackToThreeWaves`: with five waves, `A` shows all, a second `A` shows three again with `N more waves; [A] show all`; the cursor stays on its item when that item is still visible, else moves to the last visible row. Fails first: the second `A` does nothing.
- `TestRepeatedRoleStepsShowTheirOrdinal`: a ledger run with two `implementer` lane steps and one `reviewer` shows `#1` on the first implementer, `#2 x2` on the second, and nothing on the reviewer; a step that shows `round N` gets no `#`; a subagent under the orchestrator that shares a role with a lane step is not counted. Fails first: no `#N` exists.
- `TestStoppedEngineRowDoesNotSayStepsRunning`: a stopped engine row reads `2 of 6 steps` (as the awaiting-approval and paused rows do, `internal/tui/overview.go:398-402`) and, at 80x24, shows its age on the row (`2d ago`). `TestEngineRunRows` (state `stopped`) and `TestStoppedRowShowsAge` change their expected text. Fails first: the row says `running`; at 80 columns the row clips at `runnin...`.
- `TestRunTreeFixRoundGoldens`: a ledger run with an orchestrator, two done lane steps with task text, a failed gate with task text, and a second `implementer` step in progress; goldens at 80x24 and 100x30, mono. Fails first: the golden files do not exist. After `-update`, check by eye that the done steps are one line and the failed gate keeps its `gate FAIL` line and task.
- `TestInlinePaneKeepsSixOverviewRowsAtHeight24` (characterization, expected to pass at once): with a run pane open at 80x24, six Overview rows are visible above the pane. If the count is not six, stop and report; the doc sentence must state what the test shows.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first, from the list above. Run them and confirm each fails for its stated reason (the two characterization tests pass at once).
2. `compactTokens(n int) string` in `internal/tui/runtree.go`: below 1000 print the integer; otherwise round half up to tenths of a thousand with integers (`tenths := (n + 50) / 100`; `fmt.Sprintf("%d.%dk", tenths/10, tenths%10)` while `tenths < 10000`), then the same in millions with `M` (`m := (n + 50000) / 100000`). Use it at `runtree.go:223`, `overview.go:455` and `overview.go:969`. Do not change budget text (`budgets: N min, N tokens`), which is configuration, not usage.
3. ASCII gate line: when `m.cfg.ASCII`, use `x` for the cross. Do not touch the Recent row glyphs in `internal/tui/relayboard.go:365-371` (they are not part of this slice).
4. Stopped row: at `overview.go:398-402`, drop the word `running` for `r.State == "stopped"` as well as for `ownerWaitState`. Do not change `ownerWaitState` itself, and do not change `runParts` (`overview.go:1268`, a relay started elsewhere keeps slicer's own count).
5. Waves conflict marker: wrap `"! " + conflict` at `width-2-2` and indent later lines by two more spaces; leave the `both touch` overlap lines as they are.
6. Status line: in `statusLine`, when the behind notice is shown and ` ` plus the full notice is wider than `w`, use `behind main: ork daemon restart`. Keep the notice first and the clipping code below it as is. Do not change `daemon.BehindNotice` or `internal/daemon` (this slice must not touch the daemon).
7. `A` on Waves: toggle `showAll`. When it is on and there are more than three waves, add a dim line `[A] show first 3` after the last wave. Keep the cursor on its item id when visible.
8. Ordinal: add `laneIndexes(steps []runTreeStep) []int` in `relayboard.go` and make `laneSteps` use it. In the details of `runTreeLinesWithRoleWidth`, for a lane step of a role with more than one lane step and `s.round == 0`, add `#K` (its place among that role's lane steps) before the `xN` detail. This item is *proposed* until the owner confirms the format.
9. `-update` the goldens and read the diff line by line: only token counts of 1000 or more, the ASCII cross, the stopped rows and the new fix-round goldens may change.
10. Docs, in the same words the code now uses: the stopped-row sentence, `[A]` toggling, compact token counts (`tokens N` is `23.8k` from 1000), the ASCII `x` in the gate line, the ordinal, the short behind notice, the six-row rule (cite `internal/tui/view.go:183-190`), and one sentence that the tail shows markdown as written (owner, 2026-10-31).
11. `CHANGELOG.md`, last: add the entry at the top of the `## Unreleased` list (the parallel slice appends its entry at the bottom, so the two do not touch the same lines).

Do not touch `internal/engine`, `internal/daemon`, `cmd`, `internal/cli`, or the S214 items that were dropped. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`; `go vet ./...`; `gofmt -l .`; `slicer check`; `adj lint`.
- `go test ./internal/tui -update`, then review the diff in `testdata/golden/`.
- `rg -n "steps running" docs/dashboard.md` still lists the relay-started-elsewhere sentence and no longer says a stopped run reads `steps running`.
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner looks at the run pane and the Overview at 100x30 and 80x24: token counts, the ordinal, the fix-round view, the stopped row, and the Waves conflict marker with two engine slices ticked.
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner looks, in a real terminal, at dim text inside the cursor row style on a launched or fallback Waves row (S125 note).
